facts.text: Cafeteria rules don't apply here. Grab a tray, pile it high, and leave room for jello.
facts.why: Printed in quote marks as a character line, so it counts as a quote. Bluto never says this. The Bluto lines on the Moviemistakes page are his 'Over? Did you say over?' speech, with nothing about trays, jello or cafeteria rules. The real line is 'Nothing is over until we decide it is!'
facts.fix: Nothing is over until we decide it is!

fix_note.text: Nothing is over until we decide it is!

facts.why: The film is set in 1962 (the Deltas join in fall 1962). 1978 is the year it was released. The ticket number on the same card, 1962, has it right.
facts.applied_note: prom.js now takes classOf from data/film-flavour.json; Animal House set to 1962.
